label: Indian Casual Everyday Set
description: Complete contemporary desi everyday looks — casual kurti sets, Indo-western fusion, everyday sari drapes, and salwar-style bottoms as one ensemble. Pick a look and refine with extras in details.
details_tooltip: Extras: fabric, mood, occasion, accessories. Example: handloom cotton, daytime errand mood, minimal gold jewelry
